average_trade_value.description: 平均每笔成交金额（总成交额 / 成交笔数，美元）
average_trade_value.sql_compiled: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) / COUNT(fact_trades.TradeID) AS average_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades LIMIT 100
average_trade_value.sql_guarded: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) / COUNT(fact_trades.TradeID) AS average_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades LIMIT 100

average_commission_per_trade.description: 平均每笔佣金（佣金收入合计 / 成交笔数，美元）
average_commission_per_trade.sql_compiled: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Commission) / COUNT(fact_trades.TradeID) AS average_commission_per_trade FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades LIMIT 100
average_commission_per_trade.sql_guarded: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Commission) / COUNT(fact_trades.TradeID) AS average_commission_per_trade FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades LIMIT 100

commission_rate.description: 佣金率（佣金收入 / 成交金额，无单位比率）
commission_rate.sql_compiled: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Commission) / SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) AS commission_rate FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades LIMIT 100
commission_rate.sql_guarded: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Commission) / SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) AS commission_rate FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades LIMIT 100

average_holding_value.description: 平均每账户持仓市值（持仓总市值 / 有持仓的去重账户数，美元）
average_holding_value.sql_compiled: SELECT SUM(fact_holdings.CurrentValue) / COUNT(DISTINCT fact_holdings.SK_AccountID) AS average_holding_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_holdings AS fact_holdings LIMIT 100
average_holding_value.sql_guarded: SELECT SUM(fact_holdings.CurrentValue) / COUNT(DISTINCT fact_holdings.SK_AccountID) AS average_holding_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_holdings AS fact_holdings LIMIT 100

average_cash_balance.description: 平均每账户现金余额（现金余额合计 / 有余额的去重账户数，美元）
average_cash_balance.sql_compiled: SELECT SUM(fact_cash_balances.Cash) / COUNT(DISTINCT fact_cash_balances.SK_AccountID) AS average_cash_balance FROM atlas.dwd.fact_cash_balances AS fact_cash_balances LIMIT 100
average_cash_balance.sql_guarded: SELECT SUM(fact_cash_balances.Cash) / COUNT(DISTINCT fact_cash_balances.SK_AccountID) AS average_cash_balance FROM atlas.dwd.fact_cash_balances AS fact_cash_balances LIMIT 100
